chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Bakran, from Ali ibn Ya'qub, from Ali ibn al-Hasan, from his brother, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Umar al-Jurjani, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib, from his grandfather Abu Talib, who said:

I asked al-Hasan ibn Ali (peace be upon him): 'Where did you bury the Commander of the Faithful?' He said, 'On the bank of the riverbank (al-Jurf). And we passed by him at night near the Mosque of al-Ashath.' And he said, 'Bury me in the grave of my brother Hud (peace be upon him).'

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)
key_terms.شَفِيرِ الْجُرْفِ: On the bank of the riverbank

ai.seo_question: Where was Imam Ali (AS) buried according to the narration of al-Hasan ibn Ali (AS)?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the historical location of Imam Ali’s (AS) burial at the 'bank of the river' (Shafir al-Jurf) in Kufa, near the Mosque of al-Ashath, a site significant for Shia pilgrimage and prayer. The Imam’s declaration to be buried in the 'grave of his brother, Hud' underscores the Shia belief in the spiritual kinship between the Imams and the Prophets, linking Ali’s legacy to the lineage of divine guidance. This connection reinforces the concept of *Nabuwwat* (prophethood) continuing through the *Imamah* (leadership), a core tenet of Shia theology.
